title: Quarto 1.10.18: rendering PHP documents
label: Quarto rendering
checked: Quarto renders the fixture documents through the kernel to HTML, ipynb, and PDF (Typst), and the output carries tables, plots, captions, state, tracebacks, and cell options as expected. The PDF figure check ran and passed in this run.

inputs.name: report.qmd
inputs.detail: tables, a plot, cell options, an error

comparison.applies_to: the rendered HTML, ipynb, and PDF content each test asserts

cases.name: the kernelspec was written by juphyter into a temporary directory
the notebook sits below the project it finds its packages in
html renders the phibble frame as a table
html renders the phplyr summary as a table
html draws the plot from the vega lite specification
html keeps the figure caption beside the plot
html honors echo false
html carries state from one cell to the next
html keeps a multibyte string intact
html shows the traceback with cell frames
html shows both values a cell displayed
php cells are syntax highlighted
ipynb records the kernel and the php that ran the cells
ipynb carries the plot the stream output and the plain text
ipynb holds one representation per output rather than all four
ipynb loses an html table the way any kernels table is lost
ipynb drops the error output of a failing cell
the kernel publishes four representations of a plot
the run says whether vl convert was found
pdf renders the plot as a figure from the static svg
a second render reuses the daemonized kernel
the second render produces the same document
the daemon leaves no engine or watchdog behind
a kept alive kernel survives a long idle period
cases.reason: Set JUPHYTER_QUARTO_IDLE to a number of seconds to leave a kept-alive kernel idle between two renders. It takes that long, which is why tests/Engine/IdleTest.php covers the same ground against a one-second timeout.

cases.name: the process listing carries a long command line whole
the explicit kernelspec front matter needs the spec directory

exclusions: The long-idle daemon test runs only when JUPHYTER_QUARTO_IDLE is set; tests/Engine/IdleTest.php covers the same behavior with a one-second timeout.
known_differences: quarto render --to ipynb drops HTML tables and error outputs. This is Quarto's conversion and happens with any kernel.
